control: constant nominal shaft RPM, obtained from calm no-current equilibrium at the configured reference speed
energy_measure: water-resistance work R_water(U) * U * dt; not shaft energy or fuel mass
area_source: Patil et al. (2021), DOI 10.21278/brod72102, Table 1, DTMB 5415
propeller_source: Sadat-Hosseini et al. (2015), CFD and Potential Flow Simulations of Fully Appended Free Running 5415M in Irregular Waves, Table 3
scope: Quasi-steady longitudinal direct-wind approximation; borrowed class coefficients and 5415 above-water areas. No wave-added mean resistance, wind leeway, acceleration transient or calibrated full-scale speed prediction. Current crab angle is retained.
